title: 🗑️ Basic Eviction
description: 🔄 Evicts key 2 after key 1 becomes the most recently used key.

title: ♻️ Multiple Evictions
description: 🧠 Maintains usage order correctly across multiple insertions and evictions.

title: ✏️ Update Existing Key
description: 🔄 Updates an existing key and marks it as the most recently used entry.

title: 🛡️ Updated Key Prevents Eviction
description: ⭐ Updating key 1 makes key 2 the least recently used entry and causes its eviction.

title: 📦 Single Capacity
description: 1️⃣ With capacity one, every new key evicts the previous key.

title: 🔎 Missing Keys
description: ❌ Returns -1 for missing keys without affecting the cache state.

title: 🔄 Access Changes Recency
description: 🕐 Accessing key 1 changes the recency order and causes key 2 to be evicted.

title: 🔁 Repeated Access
description: ❤️ Repeatedly accessing key 1 keeps it recently used and protects it from eviction.

title: 0️⃣ Zero-Valued Entries
description: 🎯 Correctly handles entries whose keys and values are zero.
